title: Supercraftablity
description: A mod adding crafts for blocks previously inaccessible to survival players.
body:
# 🛠️ Supercraftability: Bend Reality, Break the Rules

**Supercraftability** is a Minecraft mod that shatters the boundaries of vanilla crafting. With the power of **Super-Crystals**, you can now forge items once thought untouchable—bedrock, barriers, command blocks, and more. This is crafting as ritual, as rebellion, as sovereign control.

---

## 🔮 Core Ingredient: Super-Crystals

Super-Crystals are the mythic lifeblood of forbidden crafting. Rare, radiant, and rivaled only by lapis lazuli, they’re used to shape the very infrastructure of your world.

---

## 🧪 Craftable Realities

Unlock recipes for:

| Item             | Recipe Core         |
|------------------|---------------------|
| 🪨 Bedrock         | Super-Crystal        |
| 🚫 Barrier         | Super-Crystal        |
| ⌨️ Command Block   | Lapis + Super-Crystal |
| 🕯️ Soul Sand      | Ritual Sand + Lapis  |
| 🌟 Nether Star     | Super-Crystal        |

These aren’t just items—they’re instruments of mythic control. Whether you're building unbreakable sanctuaries or scripting reality itself, you're no longer bound by vanilla limits.

---

## ⚠️ Update Notice

We don’t update often. This mod is a relic, a ritual, a snapshot of sovereign power. Use it wisely.

---

Craft with intention. Build with pulse. Rewrite the rules.

**Supercraftability** is not just a mod—it’s a mythic infrastructure.
